content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post under the District Climate Change Mission - Krishnagiri.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have basic typing skills in Tamil and English. Minimum 1 year of experience in a related field gets preference. Particular preference for candidates with 1 year of experience in a government department or government office. Data Entry / Data Management experience. Experience in government office file maintenance, inward/outward register maintenance, and archiving. Good proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Power Point. Ability to prepare government reports, letters, statistical data, and Power Point Presentations. Experience in data collection and office document work. Good communication and coordination skills.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in any of the following departments: Life Science, Environmental Science, Forestry, Wild life Science, Public Policy, or Related/Similar fields. Must also possess basic typing skills in Tamil and English.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Applicants must not exceed 40 years of age at the time of applying. Candidates must belong to or be residents of Krishnagiri district.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Salary
content_sections.text: Travel Head allowances are provided for official travel related to the post.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applicant qualifications, personal interview, and typing test. A waiting list of 2 to 3 persons will be maintained as required. Under the guidance of DCCM, the Technical Assistant's key responsibilities include coordination between departments, capacity-building events, archiving, and coordinating DCCM operations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria for the Technical Assistant post as per the notification. Prepare the application with required educational and experience documents. Ensure the applicant is a resident/native of Krishnagiri district and under 40 years of age. Send or submit the filled application to the official office address before the last date. Note the last date for application submission, which is 30.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Degree in Life Science, Environmental Science, Forestry, Wild life Science, Public Policy, or related fields) Proof of age and residency (Krishnagiri district residency proof) Experience certificates (if any, particularly government department experience) Proof of computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Power Point, Data Entry) Typing skill proof (Tamil and English)

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of 19 months. Monthly remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- with a project duration allocation of 19 months. The workplace is the District Collectorate, Tiruchirapalli, as stated in the administrative context, under the District Climate Change Mission, Krishnagiri. Applicants must be residents or natives of Krishnagiri district. The applicant's age must not exceed 40 years at the time of application. Preference is given to candidates with at least 1 year of relevant experience, especially in government departments. A waiting list of 2 to 3 candidates will be maintained as needed.

faq.question: Q1. What is DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the District Climate Change Mission - Krishnagiri to hire 1 Technical Assistant on a contract basis for 19 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DCCM Krishnagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a degree in Life Science, Environmental Science, Forestry, Wild life Science, Public Policy, or related fields, along with basic Tamil and English typing skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Applicants must not exceed 40 years of age at the time of applying and must be residents of Krishnagiri district.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DCCM Krishnagiri Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline to the office address before 30.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process includes qualification scrutiny, personal interview, and a typing test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 22,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the office address for submitting the application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to Room No. 78, District Climate Change Mission, District Collectorate, Krishnagiri - 635 115.
